description:
Join Our Team at Fuerda Smartech!

Fuerda Smartech is hiring a Financial Manager

What We’re Looking For:

✅ Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics

✅ Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a financial-accounting role, including 3+ years in a supervisor / managerial role, experience in manufacturing

✅ Advanced English skills (both written and spoken) for reporting and communication with the headquarters in China

✅ Advanced SAP (FI/CO) and Excel knowledge – mandatory

✅ Strong understanding of fiscal legislation

✅ Proficiency in data analysis, financial reports, and forecasting

✅ Budget planning and control knowledge

✅ Solid understanding of financial accounting principles

✅ Excellent numerical skills and understanding of data analysis/statistical methods

✅ Proven experience in coordinating and developing a financial department

✅ Excellent organizational and follow-up skills


Personal Profile:

✅ Organized, rigorous, and proactive person

✅ Ability to manage tight deadlines and dynamic environments

✅ Empathetic leader, capable of inspiring and motivating the team

✅ Efficient delegator – able to prioritize and trust team members

✅ Clear and open communication with both the local team and central management

✅ Balanced and diplomatic approach in intercultural interactions

✅ Solution-oriented mindset, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills

✅ Flexibility and adaptability in a changing environment

✅ Professional integrity and a strong sense of responsibility


Main Responsibilities:

✅ Coordinate and supervise the financial team’s activity in Romania

✅ Manage the factory’s budget, cash flow, and financial forecasts, reporting to the General Manager and CFO

✅ Monitor production costs and analyze key financial indicators

✅ Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing in SAP (FI/CO)

✅ Ensure compliance with local tax legislation and group internal policies

✅ Prepare financial reports and analyses for both local and international management

✅ Propose and implement improvements in financial processes and internal control

✅ Collaborate closely with other departments to support operational and strategic decisions


Benefits:

🍽️ Meal vouchers

🍴Subsidized canteen

🏥 Private medical services at Medlife (Business package)

🎁 Holiday bonuses

📈 Performance bonus

🎖️ Seniority and loyalty bonus

💳 13th salary

🏖️ 25 days of paid vacation

🚘Company car


Your expertise will lead you further with us! We’re excited to meet you!
